review_method: Independent read-only review of aggregate RESULT.json/RESULT.csv, launch and execution receipts, INPUTS.json, and the pinned local receipt JSON files. No source arrays were loaded, no remote calls or jobs were made, and no tests were rerun.

bindings.position_status: unavailable: compact source bundle has no source-bound step_in_seq sidecar; no parquet scan was performed

execution.memory_peak_note: Execution receipt reports MemoryPeak unset after cgroup removal; no measured peak is claimed.

verification.receipt_bindings: All four local receipt byte hashes match INPUTS.json pins; result manifest hash, bundle hash, receipt hashes, and current diagnostic source hashes match their recorded bindings.

label_bin_concentration.interpretation: Per-target pooled global-WP contributions were summed across targets for each shared retrospective bin of absolute clipped target. These are metric contributions, not row-frequency shares; the official metric weights by absolute clipped target.

component_concentration.interpretation: Component contributions were aggregated across both targets before ranking. Shares use gross absolute net component deltas, so opposing component effects can exceed the pair's net delta.
component_concentration.conclusion: No single component dominates gross absolute paired change in these comparisons; component IDs are descriptive audit leads only.

descriptive_prediction_on_target_moments.definition_and_caveat: The reported slope is the weighted linear projection of clipped prediction on clipped target (Syp/Syy), with intercept mu_prediction - slope*mu_target. It is descriptive, is direction-specific, and is not a fitted calibration correction or a held-out calibration result.

limitations: The 75/25 blend weight was selected on this same exposed F0 population, so wide/deep/mix comparisons are retrospective and are not independent validation.
Q8 versus FP32 mix is a same-row, receipt-bound exposed-F0 grade comparison; it does not establish generalization.
No source-bound strong-control predictions were included, so this review supports no comparison to an absent strong control and no public-causality conclusion.
Rows are the compact source selection need_prediction AND is_scored. Sequence position is unavailable, and the diagnostic did not scan the parquet or reconstruct positions.
No uncertainty interval or independent resampling estimate is reported; the small paired score differences should not be read as evidence of stability beyond this panel.
The weighted bias and prediction-on-target moments describe this panel only. They do not justify fitting or applying a calibration transform.
The execution receipt has no measured memory peak.
actionable_followups: When the historical strong-control prediction is restored or a receipt-bound compatibility route is approved, compare it on the exact same selected rows and metric, preserving the source and split bindings, then repeat the shared-partition decomposition.
Treat component 2799 and the high absolute-label bin as descriptive audit leads only; do not tune to these exposed-F0 contribution patterns.
If calibration is pursued later, specify the regression direction and fit/evaluation split up front, then report an independent held-out result.
